ravi_cs: New customer (BlueHarbor) onboarding — their SPA spikes SDK preflight calls on load and they get intermittent 429s + `RST_STREAM` errors. Demo in 4 hours. Anyone free to triage?
julia_sdk: Can you share the client error and gateway logs?
ravi_cs: Client shows `Error: stream error: stream ID 7; RST_STREAM (11)` in Chrome console. Gateway logs around that time: `429 POST /v1/preflight` and several `GOAWAY` entries for conn from 10.2.8.14.
marc_infra: Looks like stream limits + active GOAWAY policy kicked in. How many parallel preflight calls?
ravi_cs: Customer says ~70 parallel inits from multiple microfrontends.
julia_sdk: Our browser SDK isn't deduplicating init yet by default. Short-term: advise them to gate init behind a shared promise or use `sdkConfig.maxInitConcurrency=5`. I can patch SDK to add a 50ms coalesce window.
marc_infra: I can temporarily relax h2.max_concurrent_streams on eu-west edges and mute GOAWAY emission for the next 45m. Want me to apply to pool-2?
ravi_cs: Yes please, pool-2, eu-west. That should let them run the demo.
marc_infra: Done: pool-2 h2.max_concurrent_streams=220, GOAWAY-threshold suspended for 45m. Monitoring error rate.
julia_sdk: I'll cut a tiny release that coalesces preflight requests per origin (50ms), shares ephemeral token, and exposes opt-in flag `coalescePreflight`. Pushing canary.
ops-bot: Canary deploy started -> service(sdk-client): canary-2026-03-21-021, sha=beefcafe
julia_sdk: Canary logs: `preflight-coalesce: merged 62 init calls into 4 requests`. No client regressions on canary-1. Rolling canary-2.
ravi_cs: Customer retested after infra change and errors dropped from ~28% -> ~2.5%. They're good to proceed and will enable coalescing when we flip their config.
julia_sdk: I'll update the onboarding checklist and quickstart note: "If you see many 429s or HTTP/2 resets on page load, reduce parallel sdk.init() calls or enable preflight coalescing."
marc_infra: Watching CPU and stream counts — everything trending back to normal.
ravi_cs: I'll follow up with BlueHarbor in 24h and confirm full rollout. Thanks all :pray:
